interface.name: pp_control
interface.description:
A factory interface used to create control_managers per output.
This interface is exposed as a global singleton, it allows clients to control outputs' color through display hardware color control modules.

request.name: create_control_manager
request.description:
Create a color control manager for the given wl_output(a wl_output corresponds to a weston_head in the compositor, represents an output).
The display color APIs should be initialized when server side received this request.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Unbind the color control factory interface.

interface.name: control_manager

description.summary: color control manager of an output

interface.description: A color manager which would configure PCC (or other color control feature) info on one output.

request.name: destroy
request.description: The display color APIs should be deinitialized when the control manager is no longer needed and got destroyed.

request.name: set_pcc

description.summary: set PCC configuration data for server to do color control

request.description:
Send the PCC configuration data to server side.
The PCC configuration data includes a 32-bit flag (reserved), and 3 x 11 double type numbers to control r, g, b color. To avoid misaligned data, it is strongly recommended for client to include a shared header file provided by server, and construct the data based on the common structure.
The 'data' is the fd of a shared configuration file/buffer, which stores the PCC configuration data with specified format as above. The client shall not change/delete the data sent in the request before calling wl_display_roundtrip.
The 'size' is the size of PCC configuration data.
